events.title: No light
events.text: NEPA took light three days ago. Your phone is dead and the room is hot.

choices.label: Buy fuel for the lodge generator

effects.result: Light for the night. Everyone thanks you.

choices.label: Charge at a shop and endure

effects.result: Hot and mosquito-filled night.
Cooler, but the mosquitoes feasted.

events.title: Landlord wahala
events.text: The landlord says rent is going up because 'everything has increased'.

effects.result: He agrees to keep it for corpers. Respect.

riskEffects.result: He insists. You pay extra this month.

effects.result: He smiles. "Good corper."

events.title: A "gift" from a parent
events.text: A parent offers you N10,000 to 'help' their child pass your exam.

effects.result: You explain that hard work is the only way. The principal hears about it.
Nobody found out. But it doesn't feel right.

riskEffects.result: Another teacher reports you. The principal issues you a query.

events.title: PPA says no stipend
events.text: Your PPA admin officer announces that corpers won't get stipends this month. "No money."

effects.result: You adjust your budget.
The LGI officer intervenes. They pay something small.

riskEffects.result: Nothing changes, and your boss is annoyed.

events.title: Boss's errand
events.text: Your boss asks you to help carry their personal shopping from the market on your free afternoon.

effects.result: Your boss is grateful and remembers it.
Your boss shrugs.

events.title: Your cousin abroad
events.text: Your cousin in Canada calls: "Start saving now. If you have N400,000 by passing out, I'll help you apply for a master's."

effects.result: Goal set: save money for a master's abroad.

events.title: Family needs help
events.text: Your younger sister's school fees are due. Your parents ask if you can help with N15,000.

effects.result: Your family is grateful. Your sister calls to thank you.
It helps a bit.
They understand, but you feel bad.

events.title: Owambe invitation
events.text: Your landlord's daughter is getting married this Saturday. The whole street is invited.

effects.result: Jollof, small chops, live band. You danced till evening.
You sprayed the couple. The landlord loves you now.
You rest instead.

events.title: Malaria
events.text: You wake with fever, headache and body pains.

choices.label: Go to the hospital and run a test

effects.result: Malaria confirmed. Treatment and rest.
It helps, but you feel weak for days.
Bad idea. You feel terrible.

events.title: Roommate's soup
events.text: Your roommate cooked a big pot of egusi and offers you some.

effects.result: Delicious. You promise to cook next time.

choices.label: Buy them drinks to say thanks

effects.result: Good vibes all round.

events.title: CDS group drama
events.text: Two members of your CDS group are fighting over who should be group president.

effects.result: You calm things down. The LGI officer is impressed.
You won! You are now CDS group president.

riskEffects.result: You lost the election, but people know your name now.

effects.result: Not your business.

events.title: Checkpoint
events.text: Police stop the keke you're in and ask everyone for ID.

effects.result: "Corper, you can go. Serve your fatherland."
They let you go after a warning.

riskEffects.result: It wastes an hour of your day.

events.title: Job fair
events.text: A big company is holding a recruitment drive for corpers at the community hall.

effects.result: You impress a recruiter. They say they'll call after passing out.
Maybe next time.

events.title: Big client
events.text: Someone saw your side-hustle work and wants to place a big order.

effects.result: Long days, but the money is good.

events.title: Phone snatched
events.text: Walking by the road, a man on a bike grabs your phone and speeds off.

choices.label: Buy a cheap phone to keep going

effects.result: Lesson learnt: hold your phone tight by the road.

choices.label: Borrow an old phone from your roommate

effects.result: It works, barely.

events.title: Allawee rumour
events.text: Corpers in your WhatsApp group say allawee will be late this month. Panic everywhere.

effects.result: You eat beans and garri for a few days.
It turns out to be fake news.

events.title: Emergency at the ward
events.text: A road accident victim is rushed in and the ward is short-staffed.

effects.result: The patient survives. The doctors respect you now.

choices.label: It's past your hours, go home

effects.result: Someone else handles it.

events.title: Production bug
events.text: The company app has crashed and the senior engineer is on leave.

effects.result: You find the bug at 9pm. The CEO hears your name.
Customers complain all night.

events.title: Nothing to do
events.text: Another day at the secretariat with nothing to do but sit.

choices.label: Use the time to learn online

effects.result: You complete a free online course module.
Your boss is surprised. "This corper is serious."
Nice nap.

events.title: Someone special
events.text: You keep running into the same person at the buka. Today they sit at your table.

effects.result: You talk for an hour. You exchange numbers.
Maybe another day.

events.title: Troublemaker in class
events.text: A student keeps disrupting your lesson and the class is laughing.

choices.label: Stay calm and give him a task

effects.result: He settles down and even answers a question. Respect earned.
Order restored, but the class is cold toward you.
